969-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
969-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2105-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

751-3755-6965.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3025-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

3534-7084-8250.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.
3534-7084-8250.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-2506-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2113-2506-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-6797-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

225-3129-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7768.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

141-6797-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-6797-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

765-1558-2557-2638-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2557-2638-4231.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

774-5233-6664.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Boros Garrison's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1978-5776-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other creature

2506-2557-2719-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-2921-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4410-4831-5166.description:
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it, dealing damage to any target.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

628-1228-3174-5571.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
An opponent controls a creature.
628-1228-3174-5571.description:
Give control of Blightbeetle to an opponent, if needed. Also, give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1052-2921-6553.easyPrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
1052-2921-6553.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4885-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3525-4929-5482-6411.notablePrerequisites:
Sandstorm Salvager does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Sandstorm Salvager.
2060-3525-4929-5482-6411.description:
Cast Season of Weaving by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating token copies of Cryptic Trilobite and Crystalline Crawler, and drawing a card if desired.
Activate Sandstorm Salvager by paying {2} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature token you control.
Activate the Cryptic Trilobite token's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Crystalline Crawler token's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sandstorm Salvager.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrary amount of colorless mana, you may skip step 3.

957-1309-2665.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
957-1309-2665.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the token Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3605-5145-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Archon of Falling Stars' power.
Repeat.

204-1322-1858-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1322-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

3456-4499-4772.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2034-3305-3908-4753.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Clever Impersonator, adding {C}{C}.
Clever Impersonator dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, returning Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spark Double, adding {C}{C}.
Spark Double dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Repeat.

2686-3369.notablePrerequisites: You control no other nonartifact, nonland, noncreature permanents.
2686-3369.description:
Cast Decree of Annihilation.
At the beginning of your upkeep.
Barren Glory triggers and you win.

1358-1978-4131.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Sydri.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

3078-3525-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
3078-3525-4644.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.

953-1371-2870.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Enter the Infinite.
Resolve each Enter the Infinite, causing each player to draw their entire library, put a card from their hand on top of their library, and have no maximum hand size until their next turn.
At the beginning of each opponent's draw step, Anvil of Bogardan triggers, causing them to draw an additional card, discard a card and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
